source_metadata.etymology_text: Coined by Jan Svatopluk Presl based on Polish żarłok (“glutton”). Analyzable as žral + -ok. From žrát (“eat”). First attested in the 19th century. Compare typologically names for wolverine: Bulgarian лакомец (lakomec); Serbo-Croatian žderonja, ждеравац (cognate via Proto-Slavic *žьrati).
